text:
Eva: Heads-up — master CI is red after the serialization refactor in PR #4123. Golden snapshot tests failing, looks like prompt outputs changed. Anyone on call to triage?

ci-bot: buildkite: master #1254 failed — failing tests: tests/golden/test_prompts.py::test_prompt_serialization. Logs: https://buildkite.example/1234 (artifacts attached)

Mike: grabbing logs now. My guess: protobuf->msgpack switch changed field ordering or dropped metadata keys.

Tara: can you paste a small example of the diff? quick skim might help.

Eva: snippet from the golden diff:
```
- "assistant": {"content":"Hello","meta":{"trace":...}}
+ "assistant": {"content":"Hello"}
```
So metadata got stripped in serialization. Looks like #4123 set `serialize_metadata=False` by accident (or changed default).

Mike: if metadata is gone then snapshots will fail. Options: (a) rerun CI (maybe flaky), (b) bisect to the exact commit that changed behavior, (c) update snapshots if the new format is intended. For triage: run `pytest tests/golden/test_prompts.py::test_prompt_serialization -q -k serialization` locally and dump the produced JSON.

Ryan: I'm starting a bisect now on my laptop:
`git bisect start HEAD $(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)`
`git bisect run pytest tests/golden/test_prompts.py::test_prompt_serialization -q`
Should know within ~10 mins, will post results.

Tara: if we do opt to change serializer behavior, we must bump the serializer semantic version and add a migration note. Otherwise revert default to preserve backward compatibility.

Mike: agreed. Quick hotfix path: revert the default in the serializer (revert commit 9f3b2c) or add env var `SERIALIZER_INCLUDE_METADATA=1` and set it in CI for now. Either unblocks.

Eva: I opened a draft PR that reverts the default at https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4287 (branch: revert/serializer-default). Please review when you can — it's small.

Ryan: bisect landed: commit 9f3b2c changed default behavior. I ran a local job with the revert and CI rerun for that branch is queued. On my machine, reverting makes the golden test pass.

Mike: pushed a follow-up to add an explicit golden update helper: `scripts/update_golden.py --filter=prompts --dry-run`. We'll require a changelog entry if we keep the new format.

Tara: filing a short postmortem in #postmortems: root cause = serializer default change + missing guardrails in golden tests. Action items: (1) revert default (done), (2) add a compatibility test that runs previous serializer configs, (3) add docs on snapshot updates.

Eva: thanks all. For folks needing to update local snapshots temporarily: `GOLDEN_MODE=update pytest tests/golden -k prompt -q` and include `--snapshot-dir=path/to/snapshots`. When PR merges, rerun CI to confirm green. Closing this thread after the revert PR lands. :thumbsup:
